name: product-backlog
description: Bundles two Product Backlog skills: the original markdown-table backlog (docs/backlog/product-backlog.md) with a self-contained HTML dashboard, and a new JSON-backed backlog (docs/backlog/product-backlog.json) governed by a strict JSON Schema, mutated only through a deterministic Python CLI, with a live localhost HTML editor. Both analyze each Claude session for shipped, in-progress, and pending work. The JSON-backed CLI is also callable as a subprocess from other skills/projects (find, default-path, --json, auto-init on add) for cross-skill backlog integration.
